description: Browse records in the selected Vault, most recently created first. Requires read permission. Use it when there is no topic, including requests to browse a date window. Optional start_date and end_date use ISO 8601 creation dates. limit is the page size, up to 100; pass next_cursor as cursor with the same filters for the next page. Listed content is a preview: read the full record and its revision with ragionex_view_memory before an update.

cursor.description: The next_cursor from the previous page. Omit or pass null for the first page; keep the same date filters when continuing.

end_date.description: Optional inclusive upper bound for memory creation date. ISO 8601: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (end-of-day UTC) or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. Set ONLY for exact, calendar-anchored time references; omit or pass null for vague time.

limit.description: Maximum records per page, most recent first. Default 50, maximum 100. Use next_cursor to continue with the same filters.

start_date.description: Optional inclusive lower bound for memory creation date. ISO 8601: 'YYYY-MM-DD' (start-of-day UTC) or 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ'. Set ONLY for exact, calendar-anchored time references; omit or pass null for vague time.

name: ragionex_list_memories
title: List memories (browse)
